firm_data.firm_description: Futterman Lanza, LLP, helps families plan, protect, and preserve what matters most. For over 20 years, our attorneys have guided clients through elder law, estate planning, Medicaid planning, and related matters with creative, compassionate and comprehensive SOLUTIONS.
notable_facts: Offices in Smithtown, Melville, and Garden City, New York
The firm focuses on the legal needs of the elderly, individuals and children with disabilities, and their families.
Recognized as a Best Law Firm by BEST LAWYERS® in 2024

email.subject: AI for Futterman Lanza, LLP - built for firms like yours
email.body:
Hi Kate,

With three offices across Smithtown, Melville, and Garden City, Futterman Lanza manages complex elder law and estate planning matters for families who need precision and care. That scale demands efficiency without sacrificing the compassion your practice is known for.

I lead business at Lucio, an AI platform built for law firms that face BigLaw demands with leaner teams. We recently raised $5M, and firms across 9 jurisdictions have chosen us over Harvey because we focus on the realities of smaller practices: precision, client trust, and efficiency.

Having completed successful pilots on the East Coast, we're now expanding into your region to meet firms like yours. I'd be happy to stop by to share how ex-lawyers built this tool to help firms compete with BigLaw.

Worth 20 minutes?

Vasu
Lucio
